summary: Frontend-only regression pass executed for sign-in and ads routes. Redesigned sign-in loaded, sign-in tap opened external OIDC popup, /ads resolved safely to sign-in when unauthenticated, and /ads/review rendered unauthorized state without crash.

ui_bugs.component: Ads tab direct route under signed-out session
ui_bugs.issue: Cannot validate My Ads credit card/redeem controls in automation because /ads consistently redirects to sign-in for unauthenticated users.
Ad Codes panel controls were not reachable in this run because admin-authenticated state is required and third-party OIDC completion is non-deterministic in browser automation.

integration_issues.issue: Sign-in click launches external Hercules auth popup, but deterministic completion to in-app authenticated/admin state could not be guaranteed in this run.

issues: Some segmented controls use minHeight 42 (below recommended 44 touch target), which may reduce tap ergonomics on mobile.

action_items: Run one manual/admin-authenticated pass to validate Ad Codes sub-tab controls (generate/revoke/copy) end-to-end.
Run one authenticated non-admin pass to validate My Ads credit card and redeem input flow.
Consider raising segmented button touch targets from 42 to >=44 for mobile accessibility consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: ads.tsx and ads/review.tsx include required testID coverage for key new controls, improving automation reliability.
SegmentButton styles in both screens use minHeight: 42, slightly under 44px mobile touch-target guideline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials doc exists and was read. In this run, unauth route behavior was stable: root sign-in loaded, /ads redirected to sign-in, /ads/review showed unauthorized state. Authenticated/admin-only Ad Codes and My Ads credit UI remain to be validated in a deterministic signed-in session.
rca_of_issue: Coverage blocker RCA: Hercules external OIDC popup reliably opens from sign-in-btn, but scripted deterministic completion to authenticated/admin app state is third-party-dependent in web automation. Because Ads credit and Ad Codes panels are auth-gated, those specific UI paths could not be fully exercised in this run.
